Troubleshooting · 41/50 · delivery

Delivery filename collision

Failure signal

A delivery filename collision condition is reported or detected during delivery.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for delivery does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Expand filenames to normalized project, market, language, version and checksum identity.

Corrective action

Rename through the manifest, never in isolation, and regenerate dependent checksums.

Prevention

Add this verification to the delivery gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
